text: [Image #1]phone is like all chopped and skewed but as for the other interface it is a strong start
resolution: Corrected the clipped and skewed FlockBook phone without changing the accepted Gigwork wall. The phone StaticSurface is now axis-aligned so its offscreen capture and composite quad share bounds, its responsive footprint is larger, and fixed-height header, feed, message, market, paging, and navigation rows cannot flex-shrink into chopped text. All seven channel regressions, editor type checking, and the complete ReleaseFast editor build pass; the user's visual rerun and 60-second spikewatch remain the final gates.
